title: VHELM: A Holistic Evaluation of Vision Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures knowledge of religion as a school subject through multiple-choice questions from the EXAMS-V dataset.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. Performance on the EXAMS-V dataset, which includes religion as one of 20 subjects, is aggregated and not analyzed separately.
